boundary_reason: Require a complete [-100,+100] raw context window for analysis-domain events; not a validated filter-settling interval or proof that every boundary event is artifact.
rate_definition: Count of included events divided by the matching analysis-domain sample count / declared sampling frequency; not an estimated true neuronal firing rate or validated observable-time correction.
coincidence_unavailable_handling: Separate unknown from unflagged; never label unavailable assessment clean.
guard_support_description: Template peak and eight nearest active physical electrodes are descriptive proxies; neither is a validated unit observability footprint.
excluded_channel_248_guard_use: Diagnostic context only; never use its coverage as a recording-wide censoring mask.
required_reporting: Original counts alongside analysis-domain counts and omitted boundary-event identities
Declared nominal or physical time convention and matching rate denominators
Broad/tight coincidence flags, assessment availability and per-unit guard proxies
Rate sensitivity to quality censoring with counts and denominator changed together
Flagged-interval overlays and specific sensitivity checks for short-bin, synchrony or event-triggered conclusions
